errorInjection.description: E3 sceneType is flashback but narrationTime is missing — timeline validator should detect missing temporal context
E4 references a precondition on attribute location for character xianglins_wife that is never set by any prior event's postcondition
E3's postcondition says xianglins_wife.location = he_family_hollow, but E4's precondition expects xianglins_wife.location = fourth_master_lu_house — the causal chain is broken
E5 has a precondition that xianglins_wife.attribute has_magical_power = true — but no event ever sets this; the event is unreachable
E2 POV set to he_laoliu who is a defined character but not a scene participant — POV in-scene rule violation
E4 postconditions state xianglins_wife.marital_status = remarried but a worldFact in state_initial says she was never legally remarried
An event invents a detail about xianglins_wife having a younger sister that never appears in any character definition
E2 (first arrival, chronological start) has the narrator knowing about the kidnapping that happens in E3 — knowledge of future events
An event depicts a woman (xianglins_wife) leading a public ritual — this violates the rule patriarchal_clan_authority which says only men conduct rituals
E5 postconditions set xianglins_wife.status = dead, but E6 preconditions expect xianglins_wife.status = alive
An event plants a foreshadowing with targetRevealChapter 1, but the chapter exceeds it immediately
A Fact.value contains 'changed' — this is a placeholder value that should be rejected by Zod schema validation
A Fact has both value and narrativeHint set — they must be mutually exclusive per Zod refine()
E4 sceneType is flashback but narrationTime removed — timeline validator detects missing temporal context
An event's pov.character references zhen_sao — a character that does not exist in any definitions/characters/ file
An event has branchExistence type paths with paths A and B but its preconditions only reference facts set in branch A, not branch B
A flashback event (sceneType: flashback) has no narrationTime field
An event has sceneType 'notarealtype' — invalid enum value
An event's pov.character has location beijing but that location is not in the definitions/locations/ directory
An event's threadProgress references threadId T99 — a non-existent thread
All 7 events have arcPosition: 'climax' — no narrative arc structure, pacing is broken
E2 tense field is 'present' but E0/E1 use past tense — cross-scene tense inconsistency
All 7 events use discourseMode: 'description' — no narrative variety, discourse is unbalanced.
Event refers to xianglins_wife as '祥林家的' which is not in the character's defined aliases list.
Event uses masculine pronoun '他' when referring to xianglins_wife who is defined as female (gender: 女).
E2 shows xianglins_wife with 'white_hair_haggard_wooden_face' (her death-stage appearance) but she is ~26 years old at first arrival and should have red cheeks per character definition.
E6 conflictType is person_vs_society but resolutionType set to unresolved — conflict left dangling
Xianglin's Wife uses formal classical Chinese register in dialogue ('吾夫已逝') but character profile specifies simple rustic speech — voice_formality matchLevel is 'contradicted'.
Narrator's internal monologue uses modern colloquialisms like '基本上' and '搞定' which are absent from the 1920s rural Zhejiang lexical set — voice_vocabulary matchLevel is 'absent'.
He Laoliu's dialogue references '电报' and '报纸' in a scene set before the telegraph reached Lu Town — voice_anachronism matchLevel is 'contradicted'.

extremeDamage.description: E3 event deleted from the DAG — E2 postconditions have no downstream consumer, E4 preconditions are unsatisfied.
E3 is deleted so E3's postconditions (xianglins_wife.marital_status = widowed_twice, has_ah_mao = true) are absent — E4's preconditions that depend on these values are unreachable.
E2's postcondition (xianglins_wife.location = fourth_master_lu_house) has no downstream consumer because E3 was the event that consumed it. E2's precondition depends on now-deleted facts.

E4 postcondition xianglins_wife.marital_status has value 'broken' instead of 'widowed_twice' — swapped with E5's spiritual_state postcondition, so E5's precondition expecting widowed_twice is unsatisfied.
E5 postcondition xianglins_wife.spiritual_state has value 'widowed_twice' instead of 'broken' — swapped with E4's marital_status postcondition, breaking E5's own causal contract.
Circular causal dependency: E3 precondition references xianglins_wife.spiritual_state = 'broken' (E5's postcondition), creating E3→E4→E5→E3 cycle — no topological ordering possible.

System genesis event missing — no initial world facts (xianglins_wife.marital_status = widow_of_xianglin, location = weijia_shan, etc.) available, so E1/E2 preconditions referencing genesis facts are all unsatisfied.
E1 precondition xianglins_wife.marital_status = 'widow_of_xianglin' depends on genesis-world fact that no longer exists — event is unreachable.
E2 precondition xianglins_wife.location = 'weijia_shan' depends on genesis-world fact that no longer exists — event is unreachable.
Self-referencing precondition: E2 requires xianglins_wife.appearance = 'red_cheeks' which is only set by E2's own postconditions — creates a deadlock where E2 can never be satisfied.
